text:
Priya: quick thread 12 noticing intermittent 502s and duplicated downstream calls when running the next-samplekit starter + eval harness on Vercel edge. repro below.
Liam: can you paste the minimal repro and logs?
Priya: spin the sample on edge runtime, run eval harness with concurrency=18 hitting /api/run-eval using same session cookie. after ~30s ~20% 502s and repeated outbound calls. logs: 
```nINFO eval=42 req=118 handler=start session=sess-7
INFO http out req=118 url=https://hosted.api/redwood/generate
WARN sdk retry=1 reason=timeout req=118
INFO http out req=119 url=https://hosted.api/redwood/generate
ERROR upstream status=502 req=118 body="bad gateway"
INFO auth refresh=start session=sess-7
INFO auth refresh=start session=sess-7
```
Priya: note two refresh starts for same session.
Anya: our Node SDK added a refresh lock but the edge/wasm variant missed parity. starter creates client per invocation which can spawn multiple refreshes in edge workers.
Victor: minimal fixes: (1) export a singleton client from libs/redwoodClient.ts, (2) add edge-specific README section, (3) add jitter/backoff and circuit-breaker in the harness.
Priya: sample singleton I used: 
```n// libs/redwoodClient.ts
import { Redwood } from 'redwood-sdk'
if (!globalThis.__REDWOOD_CLIENT) {
  globalThis.__REDWOOD_CLIENT = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
}
export default globalThis.__REDWOOD_CLIENT
```
Liam: we should add an SDK helper like Redwood.singleton() so users don't rely on globals.
Anya: opening SDK parity PR to implement internal promise-lock for refresh and a small helper for edge singletons. draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/2040
DevexBot: PR 2040 created by Anya 12 CI queued
Victor: note for harnesses: don't blindly retry non-idempotent generate calls. mark failed evals and queue a single manual retry to avoid token waste and duplicate outputs.
Priya: changed harness to at-most-once semantics for generate; failures are queued for manual retry. reduced duplicate downstream calls when I retested.
Liam: i'll add an e2e CI test that runs the harness with concurrency=20 for 60s and asserts failure rate <5%.
Anya: checklist: SDK refresh-lock parity + singleton helper, update starter, README edge section, backoff example, harness change, e2e concurrency test.
Priya: attaching logs & minimal repro to the sample issue. will ping once PRs land. :seedling:
